The people wait in silent awe.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Climb at once without preparing
[TODO:ru] Consecrate the people, then ascend

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Consecrate the people, then ascend

shift_consequence.text:

Obedience cannot be borrowed.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Consecrate the people, then ascend

people_tremble.text:
[TODO:ru] Lightning splits the dark cloud.
The people draw back in fear.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Mock their fear of the Lord
[TODO:ru] Calm them and set the boundary

mock_consequence.text:

Speak peace, not scorn.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Calm them and set the boundary

ascend_begin.text:
[TODO:ru] The path winds upward into mist.
The air grows still and warm.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Turn back, afraid of the cloud
[TODO:ru] Climb in trust toward His voice
[TODO:ru] Rest halfway and wait for a sign
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] His sign is the climb itself.

fear_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Do Not Fear
fear_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] He summoned you to the summit.
Fear has no place on this path.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Climb in trust toward His voice

delay_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Press On
delay_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] He waits above, not on the slope.
Keep climbing into the light.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Climb in trust toward His voice

summit.text:
[TODO:ru] Light fills the cloud around you.
A voice speaks like rolling thunder.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Stand tall and meet His gaze
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] No flesh stands in His glory.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Bow low in reverence and listen

pride_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Even angels veil their eyes.
Lower your head and hear.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Bow low in reverence and listen

god_speaks.text:
[TODO:ru] Ten holy words fall like fire.
Love for Him. Love for neighbor.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Argue the words are too heavy
[TODO:ru] Receive every word in silence
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You write them on your heart.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Try to add words of your own

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Receive every word in silence

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Receive every word in silence

[TODO:ru] Carry them down to the people
